units.source_text: 玉鬘生来笑容满面，和蔼可亲。

en.t: Tamakazura was naturally bright with smiles and warmly approachable.

units.source_text: 所以虽然性格非常谨严，仍有娇艳可爱之相。

en.t: So although her nature was very reserved and proper, she still had a charming and lovely beauty.

units.source_text: 因此兵部卿亲王等真心诚意地向她求婚。

en.t: For this reason, Prince Hyobukyo and others sincerely sought her hand in marriage.

units.source_text: 亲王为她劳心，日子还未长久，却已经到了不宜嫁娶的五月，因此写信向她诉苦：

en.t: The prince had been troubling his heart over her for only a short time, but May, a month unsuitable for weddings, had already arrived, so he wrote to her to complain of his suffering:

units.source_text: “务请许我稍得接近芳容，当面诉说，亦可聊以慰我相思之苦。”

en.t: Please allow me at least to come a little nearer to your lovely presence and speak to you face to face, so that I may find some comfort from the pain of longing for you.
Genji read the letter and said:
What harm could there be in this?

units.source_text: 此等人向你求爱，乃是一件美事。

en.t: It is a fine thing for people like this to court you.
You must not simply ignore him.
You should write back to him often.

units.source_text: 便想教她回信如何写法。

en.t: He then meant to teach her how to compose a reply.

units.source_text: 然而玉鬘非常厌恶，推说今天心绪不好，不肯写回信。

en.t: But Tamakazura found it deeply distasteful and, saying that she was not in the right frame of mind that day, refused to write back.

units.source_text: 玉鬘身边的侍女中，本来没有出身特别高贵而才能优越的人。

en.t: Among Tamakazura's ladies-in-waiting, there had originally been no one of especially noble birth and outstanding ability.

units.source_text: 只有一人，是她母亲的伯父宰相的女儿，其人略具才能，家道衰落之后沉沦世间，后来被寻找出来，在此当侍女，人都称她为宰相君。

en.t: There was only one such woman, the daughter of the councillor who was her mother's uncle; she had some talent, but after her family declined she had sunk into obscurity, until she was later found and brought here to serve as a lady-in-waiting, and everyone called her Lady Saisho.

units.source_text: 这宰相君写得一手好字，人品也大致不错，所以向来有需要时，总是叫她代笔。

en.t: This Lady Saisho had a fine hand and was generally of decent character, so whenever there was need, she was always asked to write on another's behalf.

units.source_text: 此时源氏便召唤这宰相君前来，亲自口授，叫她代写回信。

en.t: At this point Genji summoned Lady Saisho, dictated the reply himself, and had her write it in Tamakazura's place.

units.source_text: 他之所以如此安排，大约是想看看兵部卿亲王与玉鬘谈情的模样。

en.t: The reason he arranged things this way was probably that he wanted to see how Prince Hyobukyo and Tamakazura would look when speaking of love.

units.source_text: 玉鬘本人呢，自从遭逢了那件不快之事以后，收到兵部卿亲王等的缠绵悱恻的情书时，也多少用心看看。

en.t: As for Tamakazura herself, after that unpleasant incident, when she received the passionate and sorrowful love letters from Prince Hyobukyo and the others, she did read them with some attention.

units.source_text: 但并非心有所爱，只是为了要摆脱那种不快的缠绕，才采取了这样的态度。

en.t: But it was not because her heart loved anyone; she adopted this attitude only in order to free herself from that unpleasant entanglement.
